point: The subject twelve receives the action: use the passive.
主詞 twelve 是接受動作的人：用被動。
why: The real subject is Only twelve of the eighty technicians, far from the blank. They are the people given places, so the verb is passive: were offered. The nearby plant is the one that offers.
真正的主詞是離空格很遠的 Only twelve of the eighty technicians。他們是被提供名額的人，所以動詞用被動：were offered。附近的 plant 才是提供者。

gloss.ex: She started an apprenticeship at a shipyard.
The intake of new students begins in May.
Her name is on the waiting list.

point: The gerund's subject is the shipment: passive being opened.
Ving 的主詞是貨物：被動 being opened。
why: The doer after without must match the main subject, the refrigerated shipment. A shipment does not open itself; customs officers open it. So the form is passive: being opened.
without 後面動作的主詞要和主句主詞一致，也就是 the refrigerated shipment。貨物不會自己開箱，是 customs officers 開的。所以用被動：being opened。

gloss.ex: The trucks wait in the terminal yard.
A freight forwarder booked the container.
Each pallet holds forty boxes.

point: After demand that, use the base form of the verb.
demand that 之後用原形動詞。
why: The subject of the that clause is every airline; operating more than fifty aircraft only describes it. After demanded … that, the verb is the base form: complete.
that 子句的主詞是 every airline；operating more than fifty aircraft 只是修飾。demanded … that 之後，動詞用原形：complete。

gloss.ex: The aviation authority approved the new route.
Several carriers cut their fares in March.
The rubber seal on the door was cracked.

point: After asked that, use the base form: be.
asked that 之後用原形：be。
why: The that clause comes after the inserted phrase in a letter that the housing authority received. Its subject is no resident. After asked that, the verb is the base form be, followed by evicted.
that 子句出現在插入語 in a letter that the housing authority received 之後，主詞是 no resident。asked that 之後用原形 be，再接 evicted。

gloss.ex: The landlord tried to evict the family.
The tribunal will hear the case in May.
Maintenance fees are due each quarter.

point: Past unreal condition, inverted: Had + subject + p.p.
過去相反假設的倒裝：Had + 主詞 + p.p.
why: The sentence has no if. The key word been comes after a long subject, so the first word must be Had: Had … been told means If … had been told. would not have been rejected is the result.
句中沒有 if。關鍵的 been 在長主詞之後才出現，所以句首用 Had：Had … been told 等於 If … had been told。would not have been rejected 是結果。

gloss.ex: The scheduling manager posts the rota on Friday.
We changed the paper stock for the brochure.
The retailer cut prices before the holiday.

point: Past unreal condition: the result clause uses would have + p.p.
過去相反假設的結果子句：would have + p.p.
why: The if clause at the end is had not been suspended, a past unreal condition. The result must match: would have opened. A full year earlier also points to the past.
句尾的 if 子句是 had not been suspended，是過去相反的條件。結果要配：would have opened。a full year earlier 也指過去。

gloss.ex: You need a permit to build here.
The board suspended the project in June.
Payment is on hold pending a review.

point: either A or B: A and B take the same form.
either A or B：A、B 形式要相同。
why: must either book sets the pattern: a base-form verb. After the inserted whose rates were renegotiated in January, or brings the second verb, which must match: obtain.
must either book 定下形式：原形動詞。插入語 whose rates were renegotiated in January 之後，or 帶出的第二個動詞要相同：obtain。

gloss.ex: We renegotiated the lease last spring.
The hotel raised its rates in June.
Ask your team lead for a sign-off.

point: Both pairs only with and.
Both 只能和 and 成對。
why: both comes right after close, and the long clause which has stayed open … pushes the pair apart. Both A and B is fixed: both the main library and the three smaller campus libraries.
both 緊接在 close 後面，長子句 which has stayed open … 把成對的兩半推得很遠。Both A and B 是固定搭配：both the main library and the three smaller campus libraries。

gloss.ex: The server team works around the clock.
The office is closed on graduation day.

point: much of goes with an uncountable noun.
much of 接不可數名詞。
why: The noun is equipment, which is uncountable, and the verb after it is singular: is. much of works with it. many, several and few need plural countable nouns.
名詞是不可數的 equipment，後面的動詞也是單數 is。Much of 可以接它。Many、Several、Few 要接可數複數名詞。

gloss.ex: She works on the assembly line.
We ordered a custom-built desk.
Heavy traffic can hold up deliveries.
Customs checked every crate.

point: Use that for a singular noun in a comparison.
比較時用 that 代替單數名詞。
why: The comparison is between The monthly fee and the fee for the new garages. The head noun is singular, so that replaces it. Plural nouns in the inserted phrase, such as structures, are not the head.
比較的是 The monthly fee 和新停車場的費用。主詞中心是單數，所以用 that 代替它。插入語裡的複數名詞，例如 structures，不是中心。

gloss.ex: The parking structure closes at midnight.
They renovated the lobby last year.
Staff need permits to park here.

point: A noun can take -ing when another verb is the main verb.
另一個動詞是主要動詞時，名詞後面接 -ing。
why: The main verb is will be seen, far after the insertion including those who have been referred by other practices. Patients already has its verb, so the blank needs a participle: arriving.
主要動詞是遠處的 will be seen，中間隔著插入語 including those who have been referred by other practices。Patients 已有動詞，空格要用分詞：arriving。

gloss.ex: Her doctor referred her to a specialist.
The practice opens at eight.
The physician reviewed the test results.

point: A -ever word takes its case from its own clause.
-ever 複合字的格由自己的子句決定。
why: After to, the blank looks like an object. But it is the subject of has the strongest plan; the review panel decides is inserted. A subject needs whoever, not whomever.
to 之後，空格看起來像受詞。但它是 has the strongest plan 的主詞；the review panel decides 是插入語。主詞要用 whoever，不是 whomever。

gloss.ex: The charitable trust funds three scholarships.
We sold the surplus stock in May.
The nurse checked the infusion pump.
The review panel meets on Monday.

point: In an inverted sentence, the verb agrees with the later subject.
倒裝句的動詞與後面的主詞一致。
why: Enclosed with … comes first, so the subject follows the blank: the original signed floor plans. Plans are plural, so the verb is are. agreement and Friday are singular but not the subject.
Enclosed with … 在前，所以主詞在空格後：the original signed floor plans。plans 是複數，動詞用 are。agreement 和 Friday 是單數，但不是主詞。

gloss.ex: Please see the enclosed invoice.
The franchise agreement lasts ten years.
The fund's portfolio includes forty properties.

point: adhere to: the verb decides the preposition.
adhere to：動詞決定介系詞。
why: The verb is adhere, separated from the blank by in all its dealings with site staff and without exception. Adhere takes to. With belongs to comply and by to abide.
動詞是 adhere，和空格隔著 in all its dealings with site staff and without exception。adhere 接 to。with 屬於 comply，by 屬於 abide。

gloss.ex: The subcontractor finished the wiring early.
Her dealings with clients are always polite.
Follow the safety protocol at all times.
The master agreement covers all future orders.
